emulators.retroarch: One program for 8-bit and 16-bit consoles, the Game Boy family and the Nintendo 64. Choose the consoles to add.
emulators.duckstation: PlayStation. Needs the BIOS from your console, placed in its "bios" folder.
emulators.pcsx2: PlayStation 2. Needs the BIOS from your console.
emulators.dolphin: GameCube and Wii. On Windows, needs the Microsoft "Visual C++ Redistributable".

bios.retroarch: Depending on the console: gba_bios.bin (Game Boy Advance), bios_CD_E.bin, bios_CD_U.bin, bios_CD_J.bin (Mega-CD), syscard3.pce (PC Engine CD)…
bios.duckstation: The BIOS from your PlayStation: scph1001.bin, scph5501.bin, scph7001.bin… (required).
bios.pcsx2: The BIOS from your PlayStation 2, for example SCPH-70004.bin (required).
bios.melonds: bios7.bin, bios9.bin and firmware.bin (optional: melonDS has a free built-in BIOS). Then set them in melonDS, Config, Emu settings.
bios.dolphin: IPL.bin from your GameCube (optional), placed in the subfolder for its region (EUR, USA, JAP).
bios.azahar: aes_keys.txt and system files from your 3DS (optional).
bios.cemu: keys.txt, with the keys of your Wii U games (for encrypted games).

games.nova: Platformer: a squirrel who copies the powers of its enemies.
games.thwaite: Defend your villages from a rain of missiles.
games.croom: Memory game: find the matching pairs of cards.
games.libbet: Puzzle: step on every tile of the floor without getting stuck.
games.ucity: Build and run your own city, in the spirit of SimCity.
games.cavestory: The great free adventure game, ported to the Mega Drive, in French.
